subject: Cleardyne vendor master - legal name & remittance info
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Cleardyne vendor master - legal name & remittance info

Hi Lena / Cleardyne AP team,

Thanks for starting onboarding — excited to get Cleardyne live as a vendor in our system. To complete vendor master creation and enable POs and invoice routing we need the following items from you:

- Legal entity name (exactly as will appear on invoices and 1099/W-9)
- DBA (if different)
- Headquarters mailing address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Remittance address (if different)
- Preferred PO contact (name + direct email)
- AP contact for invoicing and payment queries
- W-9 (or local tax form if outside US) and certificate of formation/articles of org (PDF)
- Bank wiring details or ACH instructions (we record but do not store full account numbers in email; use the secure form link below)

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx — please complete the highlighted fields and return with the documents above. If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign packet (see link below).

Target go-live (able to accept POs): as soon as we have the legal name, W-9 and remittance path — typically 3 business days for processing.

Quick ask: can you confirm the legal entity exactly as it should be entered by EOD Wednesday 11/10? If you need help, loop the legal signer and I can accept the scanned certificate.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

2) We have two remittance paths: AP@cleardyne.com for emailed invoices (US ACH), and a separate lockbox address for check remittance. Which do you prefer to prioritize for PO setup?

Lena —

Appreciate the quick reply and attachments. Short answers below so our vendor master entry aligns with accounting: 

- Legal name for our vendor master (and for tax reporting) should match your certificate of formation. Please put the full legal name as "Cleardyne Holdings, LLC" in the W-9 and on the onboarding form.
- Add a separate field for Display name / DBA as "Cleardyne Systems" so POs and procurement touchpoints show the familiar brand.
- For remittance: we prefer ACH to AP@cleardyne.com as the primary path; please confirm ACH instructions on the secure form (do not send full routing/account numbers in email). We will record lockbox/check address as secondary.

Marissa: tagging you to capture the display name and PO contact in our catalog. Rishi: can you confirm whether we need a separate vendor code for lockbox receipts?

Lena — can you return the completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx with the legal name entered as above and upload bank instructions via the DocuSign/secure link? I've re-attached the form and included a Drive folder for the two certs so procurement can package everything.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-cleardyne-onboard
DocuSign secure bank form: https://app.docusign.com/cleardyne/onboard/ABC123

Thanks,
Kim
